mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SESSION_TEMPLATE /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.sessionTemplate.deleteSessionTemplate */ WHERE TEMPLATE_ID = #{templateId}
mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.sessionTemplate.selectSessionTemplate */ TEMPLATE_ID as templateId, SESSION_ID as sessionId, TENANT_ID as tenantId, NAME as name, CREATED_AT as createdAt, CONFIG_JSON as configJson, CREATED_BY as createdBy FROM SESSION_TEMPLATE WHERE TEMPLATE_ID = #{templateId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.sessionTemplate.selectListSessionTemplate */ TEMPLATE_ID as templateId, SESSION_ID as sessionId, TENANT_ID as tenantId, NAME as name, CREATED_AT as createdAt, CONFIG_JSON as configJson, CREATED_BY as createdBy FROM ( SELECT S.*, CEIL( (@ROWNUM:=@ROWNUM+1) / #{pageSize} ) AS PAGE FROM ( SELECT * FROM SESSION_TEMPLATE WHERE 1=1
) S, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP ) A WHERE PAGE = #{pageIndex}
SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.sessionTemplate.selectListCountSessionTemplate */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM SESSION_TEMPLATE WHERE 1=1
